voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Northern California, nineteen sixty-nine. Three newspapers received letters from a killer, each holding one third of a code.
He demanded they print it. Within about a week, a schoolteacher and his wife in Salinas had broken it.
Months later came a second code. Three hundred and forty symbols. It stayed unsolved for fifty-one years.
In twenty twenty, three amateur codebreakers finally cracked it. It did not contain his name.
Two shorter codes have never been confirmed solved. And the writer has never been officially identified.
